feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. It is the iteration 6 design (score 937.1, the best raced so far, oval 20/20, s-bend 20/20, slalom 20/20) with one change: kd goes from 1.0 to 0.9 at the iteration 6 sensor lead of y = 0.06. Iteration 7 raised kd to 1.1 and moved the lead to y = 0.07 together, and the score fell to 930.9 with slalom line-loss events up from 0.65 to 0.95. That result was confounded, but it does not support more derivative damping or a larger lead. Sensor x positions, the 16 mm footprints, weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], kp 4.0, ki 0.05, base_speed 1.5, mass 0.40 and last_direction line loss are unchanged, and the values are inside their contract ranges. Kp stays at 4.0 because iteration 4 (kp 6) collapsed the oval and s-bend and iteration 2 (kp 4.5) also lost completions. Mass is at its 0.40 floor. Approval is right here: the candidate is valid, is a single-variable move from the best raced design, and the race will show whether less damping helps slalom. Plan the next revision from the race telemetry. If oval or s-bend completion drops below 100%, or slalom max_error rises above the iteration 6 value of 0.021, kd 0.9 is too little damping at this lead: return kd to 1.0, which is the iteration 6 design. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 0.65 with completion held at 100% on all tracks, test kd 0.8 next. If the result is neutral, keep kd at 0.9 or 1.0, since the remaining gains are small and a late-iteration move is not worth the runs.
requested_changes: If oval or s-bend completion falls below 100%, or slalom max_error rises above 0.021, set controller.kd back to 1.0 with geometry.sensor_positions y at 0.06. Basis: iteration 6 (kd 1.0, y 0.06) kept all three tracks at 20/20 with max_error 0.021 on slalom, and iteration 7's rise in line-loss events came from the combined kd 1.1 and lead 0.07 change.

If slalom line_loss_events fall below 0.65 with all tracks at 100% completion and steering_oscillation at or below 0.35, test controller.kd at 0.8 with the same lead of 0.06. Basis: iteration 7 suggests more damping did not help, so the damping direction is worth one more step down.

If slalom finishes but completion_time stays near 2.9 s, raise controller.base_speed to 1.6 while holding the gains. Basis: iteration 6 slalom mean finish was 2.92 s against the 3.0 s limit, and iteration 0 showed the oval finishing near 1.9 s at base_speed 1.6.
